scientific.integrity: The projective group and all stabilizers are computed exactly in \(\mathbb Q(\zeta_7)\). The proof uses the classical Hurwitz bound to show that the explicitly generated \(168\)-element subgroup is the full projective automorphism group of the smooth genus-\(3\) quartic.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns only the three explicit Klein-quartic four-bitangent representatives in the cited Zariski triple, over \(\mathbb C\); it does not classify all four-bitangent subsets or all deformations with the same embedded-topology type.

title: Projective stabilizers of the Klein-quartic four-bitangent Zariski triple
